about_the_game:
"Legend of the Holy Domain: Eternal Battle" is a puzzle game that combines casual fun and strategic challenges. It creates a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere for players with its cute cartoon art style, while integrating innovative color - sorting gameplay.

In the game, players will embark on wonderful color - organizing adventures. By skillfully moving and allocating colored liquids in different test tubes, they can enjoy the fun of thinking. Moreover, the game has set up a rich welfare system. Functions such as "lottery", "check - in", and "claim benefits" allow players to gain extra surprises while clearing levels, helping the game progress; the "mall" provides a variety of props, providing more possibilities for players to implement strategies. Whether you pursue leisure and relaxation or desire to challenge your intelligence, you can find your own fun in this game.
